title: Center
description: Centres the element horizontally, or with flexbox centres its children.

maxWidth.description: Widest the centred box may grow, as any CSS length (60ch, 40rem). Unset, it takes the full width.

gutters.description: Space kept on the left and right inside the box, so text never touches the edges. Any CSS length; 1rem by default.

intrinsic.description: Centre the children by their own width with flexbox, instead of centring a max-width box. Bare attribute.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
